title: Non unitary and nonlinear quantum generative large model design and fast large-scale training without back propagation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29571v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformer-based large models require huge computational and storage costs. Quantum computation is expected to address that due to its potential to speed up classical algorithms exponentially. Key challenges of implementing quantum large models include the linear, unitary nature of qubit evolutions contrast with the non-unitary matrices and nonlinear functions in classical Transformers, as well as the difficulty of implementing gradient back-propagation on quantum hardware. Here we propose a fully quantum large model containing all the Transformer layers, implementing the non-unitary transformations through SVD-decomposition-based quantum circuits, and approximated nonlinear activation functions through pre-trained parameterized quantum circuits. translated_title: 非酉且非线性的量子生成式大模型设计及无需反向传播的快速大规模训练
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的大模型需要巨大的计算与存储成本。量子计算因其有望指数级加速经典算法而被寄予厚望来解决这一问题。实现量子大模型的关键挑战在于：量子比特演化的线性与酉性质同经典Transformer中的非酉矩阵及非线性函数之间的矛盾，以及在量子硬件上实现梯度反向传播的困难。本文提出了一个包含全部Transformer层的全量子大模型，通过基于SVD分解的量子电路实现非酉变换，并通过预训练的参数化量子电路来近似非线性激活函数。我们还提出了一种基于多智能体强化学习的量子电路训练算法，能够在无需反向传播的情况下训练大规模参数化量子电路。
tldr: 该论文提出了包含完整Transformer层的全量子大模型，利用基于SVD分解的量子电路实现非酉变换、用预训练参数化量子电路近似非线性激活函数，并首创基于多智能体强化学习的无需反向传播的大规模量子电路快速训练算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fully quantum large model encompassing all Transformer layers, implementing non-unitary transformations via SVD-decomposition-based quantum circuits and approximating nonlinear activation functions with pre-trained parameterized quantum circuits, together with a multi-agent reinforcement learning-based algorithm that trains large-scale quantum circuits rapidly without back-propagation.
